ashtakavarga_transit_rules.description: Ashtakavarga-based transit prediction rules from BPHS Chapter 66

sav_thresholds.interpretation: Transit through this sign brings significant obstacles, losses, and setbacks. Health may suffer. Avoid initiating important activities when multiple planets transit this sign.
sav_thresholds.advice: Practice patience, perform planetary remedies, avoid major decisions

sav_thresholds.interpretation: Transit through this sign brings below-average results. Mild obstacles and delays. Extra effort needed to achieve goals. Results are mediocre.
sav_thresholds.advice: Proceed with caution, plan for delays, keep expectations moderate

sav_thresholds.interpretation: Transit through this sign brings average results. Neither strongly positive nor negative. Normal functioning with mixed outcomes.
sav_thresholds.advice: Maintain routine activities, neither overly optimistic nor pessimistic

sav_thresholds.interpretation: Transit through this sign brings good results. Supportive environment for progress. Goals are achievable with reasonable effort.
sav_thresholds.advice: Good time for important undertakings, positive outcomes likely

sav_thresholds.interpretation: Transit through this sign brings excellent results. Strong support for all endeavors. Highly auspicious period for major life events.
sav_thresholds.advice: Excellent time for new ventures, major decisions, and important activities

sun.interpretation: Sun transit gives minimal vitality and recognition. Avoid authority confrontations. Health issues related to heart and eyes possible.
Sun transit gives below-average results for career and status. Government matters face delays. Maintain low profile.
Sun transit brings mild challenges to authority matters. Some ego friction. Average health energy.
Sun transit gives normal results. Routine functioning in career and health. Neither gains nor losses in status.
Sun transit brings moderate success in career and recognition. Good time for government work. Vitality is good.
Sun transit gives strong results for authority, career advancement, and health. Government favors likely. Leadership opportunities.
Sun transit brings excellent authority and recognition. Promotion likely. Strong vitality. Father-related matters prosper.
Sun transit at maximum strength. Peak career period. Government honors possible. Excellent health and confidence.

moon.interpretation: Moon transit gives emotional distress and mental anxiety. Poor sleep and restlessness. Mother's health may suffer.
Moon transit brings below-average emotional state. Mild mood fluctuations. Public matters face obstacles.
Moon transit gives mildly unsettled emotions. Some domestic concerns. Average mental peace.
Moon transit gives normal emotional functioning. Routine domestic life. Average public interactions.
Moon transit brings good emotional state and mental peace. Favorable for public dealings and domestic happiness.
Moon transit gives strong emotional well-being. Good for travel, public relations, and mother-related matters.
Moon transit brings excellent mental peace and emotional fulfilment. Strong public support. Domestic bliss.
Moon transit at maximum strength. Peak emotional happiness. Excellent for public ventures and family matters.

mars.interpretation: Mars transit brings injuries, accidents, and conflicts. Property disputes. Blood-related health issues. Avoid surgery.
Mars transit gives below-average energy and courage. Conflicts with siblings. Technical projects face setbacks.
Mars transit brings mild competition and obstacles. Average physical energy. Some friction in relationships.
Mars transit gives normal energy and drive. Routine physical activities. Average courage and initiative.
Mars transit brings good energy and courage. Favorable for property matters and technical work. Siblings supportive.
Mars transit gives strong energy and competitive edge. Good for real estate, sports, and military matters.
Mars transit brings excellent physical strength and courage. Victory over competitors. Property gains likely.
Mars transit at maximum strength. Peak physical prowess. Exceptional courage. Real estate and technical success.

mercury.interpretation: Mercury transit brings communication failures and business losses. Education disrupted. Nervous disorders possible.
Mercury transit gives below-average intellectual performance. Business deals face complications. Writing and speech affected.
Mercury transit brings mild communication issues. Average business outcomes. Some confusion in planning.
Mercury transit gives normal intellectual functioning. Routine business and communication. Average academic performance.
Mercury transit brings good communication and business success. Favorable for education, writing, and trade.
Mercury transit gives strong intellectual abilities. Good for examinations, contracts, and negotiations.
Mercury transit brings excellent communication and business acumen. Academic honors. Successful negotiations.
Mercury transit at maximum strength. Peak intellectual performance. Major business breakthroughs. Academic excellence.

jupiter.interpretation: Jupiter transit brings loss of fortune, poor judgment, and spiritual setbacks. Financial losses. Children may face difficulties.
Jupiter transit gives below-average fortune and wisdom. Spiritual growth stalls. Financial growth is minimal.
Jupiter transit brings mild challenges in expansion and fortune. Average spiritual progress. Some teacher-student friction.
Jupiter transit gives normal fortune and wisdom. Routine religious observances. Average financial growth.
Jupiter transit brings good fortune and spiritual growth. Favorable for higher education, children, and dharmic pursuits.
Jupiter transit gives strong prosperity and wisdom. Good for investments, teaching, and spiritual practices.
Jupiter transit brings excellent fortune, prosperity, and spiritual advancement. Children thrive. Wealth increases.
Jupiter transit at maximum strength. Peak prosperity and divine grace. Major wealth gains. Spiritual breakthroughs.

venus.interpretation: Venus transit brings relationship problems, lack of comfort, and financial difficulties. Romance suffers. Beauty and creativity blocked.
Venus transit gives below-average relationship satisfaction and comfort. Luxury items may break. Artistic blocks.
Venus transit brings mild relationship concerns. Average comfort levels. Some creative challenges.
Venus transit gives normal relationship and comfort functioning. Routine pleasures. Average creative output.
Venus transit brings good relationship harmony and material comfort. Favorable for arts, romance, and luxury purchases.
Venus transit gives strong romance, beauty, and material gains. Good for marriage, partnerships, and creative ventures.
Venus transit brings excellent relationship fulfillment and luxury. Marriage prospects bright. Artistic success.
Venus transit at maximum strength. Peak romance and material happiness. Exceptional beauty and creative brilliance.

saturn.interpretation: Saturn transit brings severe obstacles, chronic health issues, and delays. Loneliness and depression. Career setbacks.
Saturn transit gives below-average results with frustrating delays. Hard work yields little reward. Health needs attention.
Saturn transit brings mild delays and restrictions. Average discipline. Some obstacles in long-term projects.
Saturn transit gives normal functioning with manageable restrictions. Routine discipline. Average long-term progress.
Saturn transit brings steady progress through discipline. Favorable for long-term investments and structured work.
Saturn transit gives strong results through patience and hard work. Property gains. Career stability and recognition.
Saturn transit brings excellent long-term gains. Discipline rewarded with authority. Property and career flourish.
Saturn transit at maximum strength. Peak discipline bears fruit. Major career milestones. Long-term wealth accumulation.

transit_modifiers.description: Transit planet in exaltation sign amplifies ashtakavarga results by 25%
Transit planet in debilitation sign reduces ashtakavarga results by 25%
Transit planet in own sign slightly amplifies results by 15%
Retrograde transit planet reduces forward progress by 20%
Combust transit planet significantly weakens transit effects by 40%
Transit planet conjunct benefic amplifies positive effects by 20%
Transit planet conjunct malefic reduces positive effects by 15%
Jupiter's aspect on transit planet provides protective boost of 15%

kaksha_effects.effect: Saturn's kaksha: Slow, methodical transit. Results delayed but lasting. Hard work during this sub-period.
Jupiter's kaksha: Expansive and fortunate sub-period. Wisdom and growth during transit through this portion.
Mars's kaksha: Energetic and competitive sub-period. Action-oriented results. Possible conflicts.
Sun's kaksha: Authority and recognition sub-period. Government and leadership matters highlighted.
Venus's kaksha: Comfortable and pleasant sub-period. Romance, arts, and luxury favored.
Mercury's kaksha: Intellectual and communicative sub-period. Business and education favored.
Moon's kaksha: Emotional and intuitive sub-period. Public dealings and domestic matters highlighted.
Lagna's kaksha: Personal and self-focused sub-period. Results most directly felt by the native.

combined_analysis.description: When SAV and BAV are both considered, use the following combination rules

rules.combined: Highly auspicious transit period. Take bold action on important matters.
Good transit period with planetary support. Favorable for the planet's significations.
Sign is generally favorable but this planet struggles. Mixed results specific to planet's themes.
Planet is individually strong but environment unsupportive. Limited gains despite personal effort.
Challenging transit period. Avoid major decisions related to this planet's significations.
Standard transit period. Routine activities proceed normally. No significant events expected.
